metadata.title: Terms of Service — PRESTIGO Premium Chauffeur Prague
metadata.description: Terms and conditions for PRESTIGO chauffeur services. Booking policy, cancellation, payment terms, liability, and governing law.
metadata.ogTitle: Terms of Service — PRESTIGO Premium Chauffeur Prague

section1.title: Scope of Services
section1.text: PRESTIGO is a trading name of chelautotrans s.r.o. (IČO: 05650801, registered at Spojovací 685, Vysoký Újezd, Czech Republic). We provide premium chauffeur and private transfer services in Prague and Central Europe, including airport transfers, intercity routes, corporate transportation, VIP and event transport, and group transfers. By placing a booking, you agree to these terms.

section2.title: Booking & Confirmation
section2.paragraph2: A booking is confirmed upon receipt of a confirmation email containing your booking reference number. You are responsible for providing accurate passenger details, pickup location, and contact information.
section2.paragraph3: PRESTIGO reserves the right to decline a booking at its sole discretion.

section3.title: Pricing & Payment
section3.paragraph1: All prices are fixed at the time of booking. There is no surge pricing and no hidden fees. The quoted price includes all route tolls and standard waiting time (60 minutes for airport pickups, 15 minutes for other pickups).
section3.paragraph2: Payment is processed securely via Stripe. We accept Visa and Mastercard. Prices are displayed in EUR; CZK is available on request. Corporate accounts may pay by monthly invoice or company card as agreed.
section3.paragraph3: Additional charges apply only for: waiting time beyond the included allowance, additional stops not in the original booking, or cleaning fees for damage caused by the passenger.

items.label: Free cancellation
items.desc: You can cancel free of charge up to {freeHoursShort, plural, one {{freeHoursShort} hour} other {{freeHoursShort} hours}} before pickup on trips of up to {km} km, up to {freeHoursLong, plural, one {{freeHoursLong} hour} other {{freeHoursLong} hours}} before pickup on longer trips, and up to {freeHoursHourly, plural, one {{freeHoursHourly} hour} other {{freeHoursHourly} hours}} before pickup on hourly bookings. You cancel from the link in your confirmation email, and the deadline for your booking is shown there. A payment made in advance is refunded in full, and a hold on your card is released.

items.label: Late cancellation
items.desc: If you cancel after that deadline but before pickup, a fee of up to {percent}% of the booking amount may apply. A person at Prestigo decides every charge, may reduce or waive it, and nothing is charged automatically.

items.label: No-show
items.desc: If you are not at the pickup point and do not cancel, the driver waits {waitCityMin, plural, one {{waitCityMin} minute} other {{waitCityMin} minutes}} for a pickup in the city and {waitAirportMin, plural, one {{waitAirportMin} minute} other {{waitAirportMin} minutes}} for a pickup at the airport. After that wait, a person at Prestigo decides whether to charge a no-show fee of up to the full fare. Nothing is charged automatically.

items.label: Saved card as a guarantee
items.desc: When you book, we save your card with Stripe as a guarantee. This also applies to bookings you pay in cash to the driver. The card is charged only by a person at Prestigo, and only for a late cancellation, a no-show or a ride that was not paid.

items.label: Refunds
items.desc: Refunds are returned to the original payment method, usually within 5–10 business days. If your flight is cancelled, you get a full refund or a new booking, at your choice.

section5.title: Passenger Obligations
items: Be ready at the designated pickup location at the agreed time.
Treat the vehicle and driver with respect.
Wear seatbelts at all times as required by law.
Passengers are liable for any damage to the vehicle caused by their actions.
section5.extraItem: PRESTIGO reserves the right to refuse service to passengers who are intoxicated or disruptive.

section6.title: Flight Tracking & Waiting Time
section6.paragraph1: For airport pickups, PRESTIGO monitors your flight status in real time. Your driver adjusts automatically to delays at no extra cost. 60 minutes of complimentary waiting is included from the time of landing.
section6.paragraph2: For non-airport pickups, 15 minutes of complimentary waiting is included from the scheduled pickup time.

section7.title: Liability
section7.paragraph1: PRESTIGO maintains full commercial insurance for all vehicles and passengers during the transfer.
section7.paragraph2: Liability for loss of or damage to personal belongings left in the vehicle is limited to €500 per booking unless a higher value was declared in advance.
section7.paragraph3: PRESTIGO is not liable for delays caused by traffic conditions, road closures, or circumstances beyond reasonable control. In all cases, our maximum liability does not exceed the total value of the booking.

section8.title: Force Majeure
section8.text: PRESTIGO is not liable for failure to perform due to natural disasters, severe weather, government actions, strikes, pandemics, or other events beyond reasonable control. In such cases, we will offer rebooking or a full refund.

section11.title: Governing Law & Disputes
section11.paragraph1: These terms are governed by the laws of the Czech Republic. Any disputes arising from these terms or from our services shall first be attempted to resolve amicably.
section11.paragraph2: If unresolved, disputes fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Prague, Czech Republic.

section12.title: Changes to These Terms
section12.text: PRESTIGO reserves the right to update these terms. The “last updated” date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of our services after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated terms.
